task: Two additional restoration thresholds matching relative online speed of Wan beta 3 and 4
interpretation: speed matching; prior three LTX quality-matched presets remain unchanged; no quality equivalence claim

reference.timing: text encoding through VAE and video encoding, excluding model loading and metrics

generation.negative_prompt: worst quality, inconsistent motion, blurry, jittery, distorted

calibration_cases.prompt: A black and white border collie running at an easy pace along a sandy beach near the water. Small waves roll onto the sand as the camera tracks smoothly beside the dog. A single uninterrupted photographic shot with stable framing, consistent natural illumination, clear subject details, coherent movement and realistic textures. No cuts or abrupt camera motion.

A woman in a green sweater turns a pottery bowl slowly on a wheel in a softly lit studio. Her hands guide the wet clay with careful continuous movements. A single uninterrupted photographic shot with stable framing, consistent natural illumination, clear subject details, coherent movement and realistic textures. No cuts or abrupt camera motion.

A little green rowboat drifts beneath a stone arch bridge on a quiet canal. Reflections of the bridge ripple across the water as the camera moves steadily forward. Soft afternoon sunlight, detailed realistic textures and coherent motion.

validation_cases.prompt: A ginger kitten steps slowly over a folded blue blanket on a sofa, then sits down and looks toward a bright window. A fixed camera keeps the whole kitten visible, with natural light and continuous realistic movement.

A woman wearing a yellow raincoat walks along a wet sidewalk carrying a closed red umbrella. A steady side camera follows her natural steps and the reflections in shallow puddles in soft overcast daylight.
A close view of a chef carefully slicing a ripe cucumber on a wooden cutting board. Both hands and the knife remain visible as three slices fall gently to the side, in a single steady realistic shot.
A small blue fishing boat moves steadily past a wooden pier on calm water. A fixed shore camera shows rippling reflections and the gentle wake in warm late afternoon light, without cuts.

selection.statistic: sum native online_seconds / sum method online_seconds on same calibration cases, averaging repeated timing per case
selection.refinement: linear interpolation between measured speed brackets; capped expansion beyond measured range; at most two new betas per round, all calibration cases and both repetitions
selection.choose: pair with minimum summed squared relative speed errors, tie by lower beta; no quality-based selection

timing_controls: GPU exclusive via runtime TimingGuard; current encoder/settings; native repeated twice per calibration case; reverse method ordering on second repeat; preserve run and video hashes

quality.reference: matching native LTX, same prompt, seed and generation

limitations: Small calibration and held-out validation, not full VBench
WAN and LTX retain different native model generation settings; speed equivalence is operational and hardware/cohort dependent
Existing shared restorer and training provenance unchanged

comparison_case.prompt: A fluffy orange cat walks across a sunlit room and gently brushes its tail against the leg of a wooden chair. A steady low camera follows the natural walking motion, with realistic fur and consistent warm light.

comparison_purpose: Add two points to the existing single-case all-method plot; new native control, compare deterministic video to v3; not used in selection or four-case validation means
